# DERIVED EDGE-CASE FIXTURE.
# Purpose: the zone= tag sets the zone type in ANY tag order; a zone with no
# zone= tag defaults to normal. Other tags (color, max_drones) are ignored in
# this slice (M1.4a), so their presence must not affect the zone type.
nb_drones: 3
start_hub: start 0 0 [color=green]
hub: slow 1 0 [zone=restricted color=red]
hub: fast 2 0 [color=blue zone=priority]
hub: plain 3 0 [color=yellow max_drones=2]
end_hub: goal 4 0 [color=green]
connection: start-slow
connection: slow-fast
connection: fast-plain
connection: plain-goal
